content_sections.heading: About Warangal District
content_sections.text: This recruitment is run by the Office of the District Collector and Magistrate, Warangal District, under the Government of Telangana. The Director, Department of AYUSH, T.G., Secunderabad, asked the Collector & District Magistrate to fill 12 posts in 6 categories sanctioned in Warangal District. The posts are meant only for the AYUSH Department under the Public Health Programme of the National AYUSH Mission. The posts follow Government permission under G.O.Rt.No.1508, Fin (HRM.VII) Dept., Dt:21/08/2026, which covers 333 services statewide (38 on contract and 295 on outsourcing basis). The people selected will work under the administrative control of the Director, Department of AYUSH, T.G., Secunderabad.

content_sections.heading: Department-wise Vacancies
content_sections.text: The Warangal District Recruitment 2026 notification has 12 posts. The table below shows the roster point for each post, as printed. For both the AYUSH Medical Officer and the Multi Purpose Worker (MPW), the 4 posts are 2 OC, 1 SC (Group II) and 1 BC-A. The other four posts have 1 OC post each. For the Psychosocial Counselor, a panel of eligible candidates may be empaneled. Those on the panel will be engaged on a call basis, as and when their services are needed. The rules of reservation for community, disability and ex-servicemen will be strictly followed as per the Telangana State and Subordinate Service Rules, 1996, read with the relevant Specific Rules. Reservation for local candidates applies as per the Presidential Order. The application form says the local status field is under the Telangana Public Employment (Organization of Local Cadres and Regulation of Direct Recruitment) Order, 2018. content_sections.heading: How to Apply for Warangal District Recruitment 2026
content_sections.text: Applications for the Warangal District Recruitment 2026 are offline only. Each post has its own application form, attached to the notification. The form is addressed to The District Collector & Magistrate / Chairman, District Selection Committee, Warangal District. Download the application form and instructions from the official website of Warangal District. Use the form for the post you are eligible for. Fill in the form. It asks for your name and your father's, mother's or spouse's name as per the Aadhaar Card, date of birth, age as on 01/07/2026, local status/district, community and sub-caste, PwD/PH/VH status and educational details. Paste 1 photograph on the application form. Enclose copies of the certificates listed below. The notification asks for self-attested copies, and the application form says all certificates should be attested by a Gazetted Officer. Enclose the acknowledgment card. Submit the filled form in person or through Registered Post at: O/o District Medical & Health Officer, Warangal District. Applications are received from 27 October 2026 to 31 October 2026, between 10:30 AM and 05:00 PM, on working days only. Applications must reach the office by 31 October 2026. Applications received after that date will be summarily rejected. The District Selection Committee is not responsible for postal delays.

content_sections.heading: Documents Required
content_sections.text: The notification asks for these certificates to be enclosed with the application form: SSC or equivalent examination Intermediate or 10+2 examination Qualifying Examination Pass Certificate Marks memos of all the years (qualifying examination) Registration Certificates of Board of Indian Medicine (for AYUSH Doctor with PG Qualification and Medical Officer Posts) Latest Caste Certificates issued by the Tahsildar / MRO concerned Study Certificate for the years from 4th Class to 10th class, and in case of private study, Residency Certificate from the Tahsildar / MRO concerned PH Certificate for candidates claiming reservation under PH Quota Relevant Certificates for candidates claiming Ex-service man quota 1 Photograph duly pasted on the application form Acknowledgment card The forms for the AYUSH Doctor with PG Qualification, AYUSH Medical Officer, Dietician, Psychosocial Counselor and Yoga Professional also ask for: SSC, Intermediate / 10+2 (where applicable) and qualifying examination certificates, each with a Bonafide Certificate Registration certificate of the concerned Board / Council, where applicable PG qualification certificate, where applicable One recent passport-size photograph Gazetted attested copies of all required certificates/documents The Multi Purpose Worker (MPW) form has its own checklist: Bonafide Certificate from Class 4th to 7th Latest caste certificate, where applicable Study certificate from 4th Class to 10th Class and/or prescribed residency certificate, as applicable PwD / PH certificate, where applicable One recent passport-size photograph Gazetted attested copies of all required certificates/documents

faq.question: Q1. How many vacancies are there in the Warangal District Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: There are 12 posts: 1 AYUSH Doctor with PG Qualification, 4 AYUSH Medical Officer, 1 Dietician, 1 Psychosocial Counselor, 1 Yoga Professional and 4 Multi Purpose Worker (MPW).

faq.question: Q2. What is the last date to apply?
faq.answer: The last date is 31 October 2026. Applications are received from 27 October 2026 between 10:30 AM and 05:00 PM on working days, and those received after 31 October 2026 will be summarily rejected.

faq.question: Q3. What qualification is needed for the AYUSH Medical Officer post?
faq.answer: A Degree in Ayurveda or Unani or Homoeopathy or Naturopathy system, after a course of not less than 4½ years, with one year compulsory internship. The degree must come from a recognized university or institution.

faq.question: Q4. What is the qualification for the Multi Purpose Worker (MPW) post?
faq.answer: The candidate must have passed the VII Class examination and must be able to ride a Bicycle / Motorcycle.

faq.question: Q5. What is the age limit?
faq.answer: The age limit is 18 to 44 years as on 01/07/2026. The maximum age is relaxed by 5 years for SC, ST, BC and EWS candidates, 10 years for disabled persons, and 3 years plus the length of armed forces service for ex-servicemen.

faq.question: Q6. What is the salary for the Warangal AYUSH posts?
faq.answer: The consolidated monthly pay is Rs.60,000 for the AYUSH Doctor with PG Qualification and Rs.40,000 for the AYUSH Medical Officer. It is Rs.28,000 for the Yoga Professional, Rs.20,000 for the Dietician and Rs.15,000 for the MPW. The Psychosocial Counselor gets Rs.500 per session, with at least 200 visits a year (on call).

faq.question: Q7. How do I apply for the Warangal District Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: Fill in the application form for your post and enclose the certificates and the acknowledgment card. Submit it in person or by Registered Post at the O/o District Medical & Health Officer, Warangal District, by 31 October 2026.

faq.question: Q8. How will candidates be selected?
faq.answer: Candidates are marked out of 100. For five posts, 90 marks come from the qualifying examination marks; for the MPW, 90 marks come from a written test. All posts get up to 10 marks for age, at 0.5 mark per completed year from 18 years.

faq.question: Q9. Is this a permanent job?
faq.answer: No. The posts are on an outsourcing basis up to 31.03.2027. After that, services will be as per need and also subject to satisfactory performance.

faq.question: Q10. How is the Psychosocial Counselor engaged?
faq.answer: A panel of eligible candidates may be empaneled for the Psychosocial Counselor post. Those on the panel are engaged on a call basis, as and when their services are needed, at Rs.500 per session.
